definitions.ask: How should the brief's Still open lists behave for periods that already ended?

choices.label: Rebuild Kept 3+ and No linked minutes as of span end; omit Blocked projects with a note
Omit every Still open list for ended periods and print one explanatory line
Keep today's lists but title them "as of today" for ended periods
